{{Top|leg}}
The [[Administration Services Building]] was located in the [[Civilized sector]] on [[New Apsolon (city)|New Apsolon]]. It was [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] first stop when they went to New Apsolon, where they were greeted by [[Balog (Human)|Balog]], the [[Chief Security Advisor]] and their official greeter.
